purpose: Flyway Java migration entry point that runs the full initial schema by delegating to MigrationRunner with the ordered list of all 27 table TransitionPlans.
businessRules: Must live in package db.migration (no com.shrestaexclusive prefix) for Flyway classpath:db/migration scanning to discover it.

Passes all TransitionPlans to MigrationRunner.run() in dependency order: extensions → category → media → storefront → store locator → admin → customer identity (includes UatSeedAccountsMigration) → customer chat → customer orders → customer order drafts.
MigrationRunner handles per-table version tracking; this class simply lists plans.
To add a future column or table: create a new V2__<Description>.java and add only the relevant TransitionPlan(s) — do not modify this file.
Each table's full SQL history lives in its own *Migration class under db.migration.tables.
UatSeedAccountsMigration is included in the customer identity group — it creates the uat_seed_accounts table used by CustomerAuthService for static-OTP dev/UAT login.
